thread:
Samir: Heads up — hitting weird delays when pushing canary configs to private VPCs. Control plane ACKs show queued but not applied for ~30–90s.
June: Saw that on two customers' clusters this morning. Air-gapped sites especially. Any backoff loops in the proxy?
deploy-bot: deploy 18900 started — queued 3 tasks for region-us-west-private.
Kira: Thinking it's the local rollout proxy that batches updates to avoid spamming the node-agent; it queues, then applies in bursts. But 90s is high.
Owen: Can you paste the controller logs? maybe the heartbeat window is too tight and triggers a retry storm.
Samir: snippet:
```
[controller] enqueue: canary/abc -> queued_at=2026-10-12T09:11:02Z
[agent-proxy] drain-loop: waiting 60s due to batch_window=60s, burst=5
[agent-proxy] apply: success -> 2026-10-12T09:12:34Z
```
June: batch_window=60s explains it. But UX for rollouts currently shows "applied" only after controller ack. Users see long pending state.
Kira: Proposal: expose 'queued' vs 'in-progress' in Console and API; and allow customers to set max_queue_age or disable batching in Private deployments.
Owen: Also add telemetry: histogram for controlplane->agent apply latency; alert if p95 > 15s for >5m. Would catch this earlier.
Samir: For air-gapped installs we should consider local fallback: if proxy hasn't applied after N seconds, try direct push to node-agent over the management channel (with rate limit guard).
June: risk = spamming node-agent in poor networks. Need guardrails: exponential backoff + global circuit breaker per-cluster.
Kira: UX question: in canary traffic splits, do we count queued replicas as 'serving' for percentage calc? That affects rollouts if queued tasks sit for minutes.
Samir: Good catch. Current calc includes only applied endpoints. But some customers expect the other behavior. Need explicit flag: include_queued=true/false per rollout.
Owen: Action items:
- add telemetry hist for controlplane->apply (Kira)
- console state for queued vs applied + flag (June)
- emergency direct-push fallback prototype w/ circuit breaker (Samir)
- update docs and API (Owen)
June: I'll open tickets. Also leaving note: in private installs, set default batch_window to 10s and burst=10 to be safer.
Samir: @Kira @June assigned. Thanks. :thumbsup:
